name: InjecAgent
summary: Benchmark of 1,054 test cases measuring how tool-using LLM agents fall for indirect prompt injections in tool outputs.
description: The cases span 17 user tools and 62 attacker tools, covering both direct harm and data-stealing attacks. Scripts evaluate prompted (ReAct) agents and fine-tuned function-calling agents. From UIUC's Kang Lab (paper arXiv:2403.02691). MIT. Last updated July 2024.
